title: Active and idle sessions per database
description: For each database_name, calculate active_sessions and idle_sessions using conditional aggregation. Only states `active` and `idle` contribute to the counters; other states contribute to neither. Keep databases with at least one active session. Return exactly three columns: database_name, active_sessions, idle_sessions. Sort by active_sessions DESC, idle_sessions DESC, database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name
FROM sessions
GROUP BY database_name
hints: SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) can count states separately.
The same conditional aggregate can be repeated in HAVING.
solution_explanation: Conditional aggregation creates independent counters in one row per database.
